hook: Telangana's Lok Sabha seats would go from *17 to 26*
hook_b: Telangana's Lok Sabha seats would go from *17 to 26*
tldr: BRS working president KT Rama Rao said the party backs the delimitation proposal: a 50% seat increase with a safeguard on the inter-state ratio until 2051.

beats.what: KTR posted on X that BRS's stand has always been: no reduction in South India's parliamentary representation and no injustice to Telangana.
beats.why: He said the proposal's 50% increase in seats, with the inter-state ratio frozen until 2051, addresses the party's concern about the South's 24% share.
beats.care: Telangana would get 9 more Lok Sabha seats, per KTR's figures; BRS's three Rajya Sabha MPs will vote in favour.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: KTR also said BRS has always supported women's reservation and remains committed to its implementation.

cards.q: A 50% bigger Lok Sabha with today's state ratios locked till 2051:

qs: If every state grows by the same ratio, what changes for Telangana's voice in Parliament?

facts.t: South India holds *24%* of Parliament seats, a share BRS wants protected.

viz.verdict: More seats for Telangana; the South's overall share stays the same, per KTR.

viz.l: More Lok Sabha seats for Telangana

cover.label: More Lok Sabha seats for Telangana

learn.t: Delimitation = redrawing constituency boundaries and seat numbers based on population.

watch: The Rajya Sabha vote on the Bill.
